title: Skip the Candle This Year
why: Holiday gift guide (Nov to Dec): social and private gift cards matched to the people on the list.
hook_options: A gift that comes with a river.
For the person who has everything except time.
caption: Skip the candle. A social sauna gift card is $59 for one seat. A private card is $539 for up to 10 guests. Delivered digitally, they pick the date. Send this to whoever's hard to shop for. #EbbAndEmber #PortlandGifts #PortlandSauna #ExperienceGift

slides.headline: Skip the candle this year.
slides.body: Give someone 1 hour 45 minutes of heat, river, and quiet. Digital gift cards, nothing to wrap.

slides.headline: One seat: $59.
slides.body: A seat in a shared session. They pick the date. Works for coworkers, siblings, and the friend who has everything.

slides.headline: The friend who's always cold.
slides.body: Gray December, sweater on indoors. Hand them 180 degrees and a river view.

slides.headline: The whole sauna: $539.
slides.body: A private session for up to 10. A birthday, a reunion, a family that needs one afternoon off screens.

slides.headline: They book it. You plan nothing.
slides.body: Delivered digitally. They choose a social or private slot that fits their week.

slides.headline: Two social seats: a date that isn't dinner.
slides.body: Two $59 cards and an evening slot. The dock lights do the rest.

slides.headline: Whoever just moved to Portland.
slides.body: Their first gray winter is coming. Show them rain looks better from inside the cedar.

slides.headline: Tell them the plunge is optional.
slides.body: Some people hear river and tense up. There's a cold shower on deck, and skipping the plunge is fine.

slides.headline: One person off your list.
slides.body: Gift cards at ebbandember.com/shop. Send this to whoever's hard to shop for.
